get.description: The host's projects (host only).

post.description: Adds a project (host only).

get.description: Disk use of the Grove's data folder and the workspace mode (host only).
The models on the Ollama server the Grove uses (host only).

post.description: One prompt to an Ollama model, answered whole (host only).

get.description:
The Grove's address, whether it's temporary, the server's IP, and any change of address in progress (host
only).

post.description: Where a domain points now, and the DNS record to add (host only).
Asks the server's root helper to move the Grove to a domain (host only; servers set up with the installer).

get.description:
Whether the Grove still needs its host account (and a setup code), how passwords are recovered, and its
public address. Needs no sign-in.

post.description:
Creates an account and signs in. The first account is the host's and needs the setup code; any other needs
an invitation or a space's public link.
Signs in with email and password, setting the session cookie.

get.description: The signed-in person: name, email, roles, what they may do, and Public chat's settings.

post.description: Signs out: ends this session and clears its cookie.
Changes the password. Every other session ends; this one is renewed.
Sets a new password with a reset code from the host. Every session ends.

get.description: The spaces the person belongs to, oldest first, each with its topic and their role.

post.description:
Starts a space, with its creator as owner. Members may start spaces unless the Grove's owners turned that
off.

put.description: Renames the space and sets its topic (space owners).

delete.description: Deletes the space for everyone: its members, invitations and everything written in it.

get.description: The space's members and their roles.

put.description: Makes a member an owner or a member of the space (space owners). A space keeps at least one owner.

delete.description: Removes someone from the space (space owners), or lets a member leave it. The last owner can't leave.

post.description: A one-use invitation to the space, valid for 7 days (space owners).

get.description: The space's public invite link, if it has one (space owners).

post.description: Creates the space's public link, replacing any earlier one (which stops working).

delete.description: Turns off the space's public invite link (space owners).

post.description: Joins the space an invitation or public link is for.

get.description:
The space's items, newest first: shared ones and the person's own private ones, optionally of one kind or
matching a search.

post.description: Adds an item: a board post, note, task, event, chat message, list, list item or comment.

put.description:
Changes an item: its author or a space owner; tasks and list items are anyone's to edit. Sends the version
it read; a stale one gets 409.

delete.description: Deletes an item: its author, a space owner, or whoever keeps the list it is on.

get.description: Server-sent events: a notice whenever something in the space changes, for open pages to refetch.
The space and every item the person can see, as a JSON download.
Whether the host's mailbox is configured for reading and sending, and the Grove's version (host only).
A folder of the space's files (or its trash), with the room used and the size limits.

post.description: Creates a folder.

Starts uploading a file, or a new version of one, after checking its size against the space's room and the
server's free space. The file then goes up in pieces.

get.description: How much of an upload has arrived, to resume it.

put.description: One piece of an upload, at most 8 MB, at the given offset; the request body is the bytes.

post.description: Completes an upload once every byte has arrived, adding the file or its new version.

get.description:
A file's content, or an older version's, to download or (inline) to view. Anything not shown inline is
sandboxed.
A folder and everything in it, as one .zip: how a website leaves the Grove for its host.
A file's versions, newest first.

put.description: Renames, or moves to another folder; a folder takes everything in it along.

delete.description: Moves a file, or a folder with everything in it, to the trash.

post.description: Restores something from the trash: whoever added it, or a space owner.

delete.description: Deletes something in the trash for good. Space owners only.

get.description: The workspace kits a space owner can stage, and those already staged in the space.

post.description: Stages a kit's folders, files and items in the space, once per kit (space owners).
What a kit would add, without adding it (space owners).

put.description: Saves a text file from the editor as a new version. Sends the version it read; a stale one gets 409.

get.description: The person's draft of a text file.

put.description: Keeps the person's unsaved edits to a text file as their draft.

delete.description: Throws away the person's draft of a text file.

post.description: A signed address for previewing a folder of the space as a website.

get.description:
A file of a website preview at the signed address preview_token gave. Needs no sign-in: the signature is the
permission.

Everyone with an account: Grove role, host and webmaster, how many spaces, and when last active (Grove
owners and managers).

put.description: Makes someone a Grove owner, manager or member (Grove owners). The host is always an owner.
Webmasters change the Website folders and publish the Grove's website, as owners do.

get.description: The Grove-wide settings (Grove owners and managers).

put.description: Changes the settings sent; the others stay as they are.

get.description: Every space, whoever started it, and the room its files take.

Newest first. `person` matches what someone did and what was done to them; pass the
returned `next` as `before` for older rows.
What people asked for with the wish lamp, newest first.

post.description:
Sends the host a wish: emailed when the Grove has an address for wishes and can send mail, otherwise kept
for the host.

get.description: The last 10 website imports and how they went (webmasters).

post.description:
Starts copying a public website into a space's Website folder (webmasters who are members of the space; one
import at a time).

A .zip in Files, such as a site that isn't online yet, unpacked into Website/<its name>.
Unpacking again adds new versions of whatever changed and deletes nothing, as importing does.

A one-page website for a Grove that has none yet, in Website/<the Grove's address>. When the
space already has one, says where it is (existed) and leaves it as it is.

get.description: The published website, every space's sites, and, for owners and webmasters, the kept releases.

post.description: Anyone in the Grove may look at its websites before they're published.

get.description: Everything in a website's folder, for the site editor, with this webmaster's drafts.

post.description: Publishes a site folder of a space as the Grove's website (webmasters who are members of the space).
Makes a kept release the live website again (webmasters).

get.description: A website as its preview pane needs it: its pages, its notes, and a mark that changes with its files.

post.description: Leaves a note, or suggested wording, on a page of a space's website.
Replies to a website note.

put.description: Marks a website note done, or open again: whoever left it, or the website's owners and webmasters.

delete.description: Deletes a website note: whoever left it, or the website's owners and webmasters.

get.description: Everyone who shares a space with the person: who they can write to.
The person's conversations, most recent first.

post.description: The conversation with this person: the one there is, or a new one.

get.description: One conversation with its latest messages, and whether the person can still write in it.

post.description: Marks a conversation read.
Sends a message (text, photos, files) to someone the person still shares a space with.

delete.description: Takes back a message: its words, photos and files go for everyone; that something was said stays.

post.description: A photo for the next message, sent as the request body.

get.description: A photo from Messages, for the people in its conversation, or its uploader before it is sent.

post.description: Starts uploading a file for Messages, up to the Messages size limit.

get.description: How much of a Messages upload has arrived.

put.description: One piece of a Messages upload, at most 8 MB, at the given offset.

post.description: Completes a Messages upload once every byte has arrived.

get.description:
A message's file, for the two people in its conversation (or its sender, before it's sent).
It always downloads: a page or a script in it never runs at the Grove's address.
How many messages the person hasn't read.

Tells this person's open pages when a conversation of theirs changes, and, as `website`
events, when one of the Grove's websites or its notes does: every signed-in page has this open.
Returns the live UNSEEN count from the IMAP server.

get.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

get.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

get.description: Fetch full message body by account and sequence number.
get.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

post.description: Sends an email from the host's mailbox (host only).
post.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

post.description: Launch Thunderbird in the specified view (mail, calendar, or compose).
post.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

get.description: Return the personal IRC client connection config.
get.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

post.description: Save the personal IRC client connection config.
post.x-grove-served-only-with: the host's tools on (GROVE_HOST_TOOLS not off); otherwise every route here answers 404

get.description:
The Grove's name, tagline, colours, links and picture addresses, for the sign-in and members' pages. Needs
no sign-in.
The Grove's logo. Needs no sign-in.
The Grove's sign-in picture. Needs no sign-in.
The Grove's look as saved, with each setting described (Grove owners).

delete.description: Back to the host's settings. Pictures the owners uploaded go too.

post.description: The theme a changed look would give, without saving it (Grove owners).

put.description: Replaces the Grove's logo or sign-in picture (Grove owners); the request body is the image itself.

delete.description: No logo, or no login picture, whatever the host's settings say.

post.description: A picture from Files, such as the logo on the Grove's website.
What a website in Files looks like: suggestions to review, nothing saved.

get.description: The source code of this Grove (AGPL-3.0 section 13), as a zip. Needs no sign-in.
Whether the Grove is up, with its name and version. Needs no sign-in.
